title: Agentic-MatriBO: Capability-Compiled Agentic Bayesian Optimization for Materials and Chemical Design
abstract: arXiv:2610.17832v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Materials and chemical optimization must choose the next synthesis, characterization, or high-fidelity simulation from sequential observations under a limited budget. Large language models can use task knowledge to propose adjustments, but composing surrogates, acquisition functions, and search strategies is constrained by compatibility, parameter dependencies, and evidence requirements. We present Agentic-MatriBO, a capability-compiled agentic Bayesian optimization (BO) framework that represents BO components and selection conditions as composable capabilities. A language policy proposes BO recipes and candidate plans; a compiler checks proposals against the registered capability catalog; and a deterministic execution layer validates and commits candidates. Oracle observations are stored in research memory and inform later rounds. We compare Agentic-MatriBO with eight baselines on four offline finite candidate pools---COF, PCE10, Buch

translated_title: Agentic-MatriBO：面向材料与化学设计的能力编译型智能体贝叶斯优化
translated_abstract: 材料与化学优化必须在有限预算下，基于序列化观测来选择下一次合成、表征或高保真仿真。大语言模型能够利用任务知识提出调整方案，但组合代理模型、采集函数与搜索策略时，会受到兼容性、参数依赖性和证据要求的限制。我们提出了Agentic-MatriBO，这是一个能力编译型的智能体贝叶斯优化（BO）框架，它将BO组件和选择条件表示为可组合的能力。语言策略提出BO配方和候选计划；编译器根据注册的能力目录对提案进行检查；确定性执行层负责验证并提交候选方案。Oracle观测结果被存储在研究记忆中，并为后续轮次提供信息支持。我们在四个离线有限候选池——COF、PCE10、Buch……上与八个基线方法进行了比较。
tldr: 提出了能力编译型智能体贝叶斯优化框架Agentic-MatriBO，将BO组件表示为可组合的能力，由大语言模型策略提出优化配方，经编译器检查和确定性执行层验证后用于材料与化学设计。
en_tdlr: Agentic-MatriBO is a capability-compiled agentic Bayesian optimization framework that represents BO components as composable capabilities, where an LLM-based language policy proposes optimization recipes that are checked by a compiler and validated by a deterministic execution layer for materials and chemical design.
